name: who-iris
description: What a consumer of the WHO Institutional Repository for Information Sharing needs to know about how it is built — DSpace, and qualified Dublin Core. Named here rather than inferred from the directory: every instance's skills live in a directory called `skills`, so a package id taken from the basename collides with every other one. See bean `nlvl` for the measurement and `bootstrap/skills` for the precedent this follows.
